newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal sets contract high on China, soybeans.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal sets contract high on China, soybeans.

text.p: CBOT soymeal futures opened higher on Wednesday and the May contract topped the $300.00 per ton level on talk China bought U.S. supplies and on strong gains in soybeans, traders said.
Contract highs were notched in the May, July, August and September.
China is said to have purchased up to 40,000 tonnes of soymeal overnight, floor and cash sources said.
However, U.S. soymeal exporters said that U.S. prices were too high for China to consider U.S. soymeal and characterized the purchase as highly unlikely.
The new high for the May contract is $303.00 per ton, topping the previous high of $300.00 set on Tuesday and the highest level for a nearby contract since the 1988 drought.
At 1013 CDT, soymeal was up $3.00 to $1.70 per ton with July up $2.50 at $295.00. Soyoil was up 0.12 to 0.06 cent per lb with July up 0.11 at 25.17.
